item.title: Former Fauci adviser Dr. David Morens pleads guilty to concealing COVID-related records
item.description: Dr. David Morens, a former aide to Dr. Anthony Fauci, has pleaded guilty to violating federal law by trying to conceal emails about the origins of the COVID-1 pandemic.

item.title: In new filings, Kennedy Center says it won't try to put Trump's name on facade until Sept. 8
item.description: Lawyers for Rep. Joyce Beatty asked a judge to rule speedily on the complex's renovation and entrance tarp. The National Symphony Orchestra also announced its new season, away from the Kennedy Center.

item.title: Why does the U.S. military seem stymied in the war with Iran?
item.description: Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn says while the U.S. military is facing long-range missile shortages, prolonged deployments and vacated regional bases, Iran is building cheaper weapons quickly.

item.title: This high-speed star is whipping around the black hole in the middle of our galaxy
item.description: Researchers have identified a speed demon at the heart of the Milky Way. This fast-moving star may yield insights into the black hole parked at the center of our galaxy.

item.title: A real-world study of Oregon's nonmedical psilocybin program shows promise
item.description: Oregon was the first state to establish a legalized and regulated psilocybin industry. Since then, thousands have tried magic mushrooms. Here is the latest data from the state's real-life experiment.

item.title: Greetings from Trouville-sur-Mer, a beach town little changed since Monet painted it
item.description: The Normandy beach town of Trouville-sur-Mer is a two-hour train ride from Paris, but feels a world away, with English Channel breezes and the sound of seagulls screeching through the cobbled streets.

item.title: Striking hospital employees sound alarm over workplace violence
item.description: In addition to pay, striking hospital workers say patient violence is an issue. Hospital workers are seven times more likely to be injured at work due to violent acts than the general working population.
